text:
maya: Heads-up — SCIM group sync started failing right after last night's KMS key rotation. Okta provisioning shows 403 on /Groups PATCH.

aj: Confirmed. Several users lost RBAC roles in the last hour. Looks like group membership didn't reconcile.

nina: Quick scan of our SCIM service logs shows `403 invalid signature` when verifying the provisioning token. KMS rotation changed the signing key id (kid).

okta-bot: [okta.provisioning] error 403, message: 'Token signature validation failed', requestId: req-8a3f.

sam: Can you paste the raw Authorization header from the SCIM request? need the `kid` from the JWT header.

aj: here's the excerpt from our logs:```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjEwMjM0LWtleS1vZyJ9...
JWT header -> {"alg":"RS256","kid":"10234-key-og"}
SCIM endpoint -> /api/v2/scim/Groups/patch```

nina: That `kid` is the old KMS key. After rotation we generated new key and updated runtime env for API but not the SCIM signing service (two separate deploys). SCIM service is still signing with old key which is removed from JWKS endpoint. Okta sees mismatch.

maya: That would explain RBAC fallout. The Console's audit logs show a spike in provisioning errors at 2026-03-18T03:04:xxZ.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: service=scim-signer env=prod sha=7f2a1 (2026-03-18T02:50:10Z)

sam: Steps I suggest: 1) Re-add old public key to JWKS (temporary) OR rollback scim-signer to pre-rotation. 2) Re-run group sync. 3) Post-mortem on deploy gating for key rotations.

aj: We tested re-adding old pubkey to idp JWKS and group sync partially resumed — about 80% of groups reconciled. Some users still missing due to partial rate limits.

security-oncall: Flagging as P1 for now due to RBAC impact. Start incident timeline and capture all audit.log entries for provisioning between 02:45-03:30Z.

nina: Root cause summary: KMS key rotation updated signing key for services A (auth) and B (api-gateway) but SCIM signer (service C) did not pick up new key. PRT: missing deploy step in rotation playbook.

sam: Commands we used to validate JWKS:```bash
curl -s https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys[].kid
# and verify jwt header
echo $TOKEN | cut -d'.' -f1 | base64 -d | jq
```

maya: Also discovered audit/logging quirk — provisioning errors were being sent to a low-retention sink. We should forward those to long-term audit bucket for at least 90 days.

security-oncall: Action items: [maya] reconfigure audit sink -> long-retention, [nina] update rotation playbook and add checklist item to deploy scim-signer, [aj] re-run full SCIM bulk sync and validate RBAC, [sam] add automated test in CI that rotates keys in staging and verifies JWKS propagation.

aj: Working on running bulk sync now. Will post results.

deploy-bot: Job started: scim-bulk-sync run-2026-03-18-03:12 (eta ~8m)

aj: Bulk sync completed. Remaining mismatches: ~12 users in one nested group. Manually fixed those while we keep JWKS old key live.

nina: I'll schedule a hotfix deploy to make SCIM signer consume KMS key metadata dynamically (avoid env pin). ETA 4h.

maya: Note for compliance: we need to record the time window of privilege loss and notify affected customers if SLA impacted. I'll coordinate with legal and CS.

security-oncall: Also add vuln-triage note: rotation playbook gap is process risk. Not a CVE but process vulnerability. We'll include remediation in Q2 OKRs.

sam: One-off checklist snippet we added to playbook:```
- rotate KMS key -> publish new key to JWKS endpoint
- ensure all services (auth, scim-signer, api-gateway) read key from KMS or JWKS
- trigger smoke: POST /internal/health/scim-signature-check
- verify audit logs for provisioning errors
```

maya: Thanks — keep me posted if anything else pops up. I'll open an incident ticket with timeline and assign follow-ups.

aj: filing ticket now -> INC-2026-4827. tagging owners. :white_check_mark:

security-oncall: Closing thread for live troubleshooting. Re-open if new failures observed. :lock:
